timing_notes.duration_minus_one: natural resource lifetime or engine-managed lifetime; retained as -1 rather than guessed

confirmed: Every top-level EFFECT file_name used by the listed commands resolves to an extracted CFX file.
Every selected CFX Spine/particle source resolves to an extracted Spine JSON/SCSP1U or particle XML.
CFX z, x/y, scale, rotation, delay, lifetime, loop and animation fields are copied directly from plist data.
Particle emitter blend constants, timings, textures and motion fields are copied directly from particle plist data.
SELF/TARGET/CENTER/FRONT/SCREEN placement, ATTACH/POSITION bone mode, slot, offsets, zorder and global_z are copied from SRMD.
All 13 referenced camera, camera_path and node SCSP1U files close structurally and their rotate/translate/scale/shear keyframes are decoded in heidemarie-30093-ancillary-motions.json.
inferred: foreground/background labels are inferred only from the sign of local CFX z.
start_ms_graph is an accumulated dependency-graph delay; it should be validated against runtime playback when natural-lifetime effects gate later nodes.
When a CFX Spine layer omits ani, resolved_animation uses animation if present, otherwise the sole animation.
unresolved: duration=-1 effect nodes rely on resource/engine lifetime and are not converted to a forced duration.
No selected CFX layer uses a non-empty attach field; exact named attachment semantics therefore remain unexercised.
Several CFX particle instances use scale=-1; the value is preserved, but whether the client treats it as mirroring or as an engine sentinel is not proven.
Particle positionType, emitterType and burningType numeric enums are preserved without assigning undocumented client-specific names.
Fourteen shared particle SCT texture paths are referenced, but none are present in this character-only import or its External raw subset.
Camera-shake basenames can exist in both camera/ and effect/ namespaces; SRMD SHAKE is treated as camera-first, and all matching paths are retained.
